purpose: Verified facts used by the valuepicks/ board: day-1 review, roster-change intelligence, per-fixture series formats, team-identity evidence for Hotspawn name variants, and the market quotes that let every open fixture carry a pick. Ladder entries are only kept while their fixture is still an open row of the executive capture.

tiers.official: Primary official source (league/event organiser or the official Valve standings file).
tiers.primary-book: Direct bookmaker price page or bookmaker API capture.
tiers.relayed-book: A bookmaker price reported by a third party or a price listing site (secondary).
tiers.secondary-news: Esports news outlet reporting a result or roster change (secondary, cross-checked).
tiers.project: This project's own derived line from official rating inputs. Model estimate, not a book.

facts.claim: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 day 1, Group A opener: 9z beat Aurora 2-0 (Inferno 13-11 to 9z, Nuke 13-1 to 9z).
facts.source_name: HLTV news 45718 - 9z beat Aurora 2-0 to kick off TWC 2026
facts.detail: Published 14-10-2026 13:49. Reports Inferno 13-11 and Nuke 13-1 and describes Aurora as the fifth-ranked team in the VRS at the time.

facts.claim: 9z vs Aurora scoreline and map winners confirmed on the official match page (match over, 2:0).
facts.source_name: HLTV match 2399384 - 9z vs Aurora, Thunderpick World Championship 2026
facts.detail: Veto: 9z picked Inferno, Aurora picked Nuke, Dust2 left over. Page shows 'Match over' with 9z 2 : 0 Aurora; Inferno halves (8:4; 5:7); Nuke (11:1; 2:0).

facts.claim: Individual performance in the upset: luchov (9z) 1.61 rating, 38-20, 97.4 ADR; kyxsan (Aurora) 0.53 rating.
facts.source_name: HLTV news 45718
facts.detail: HLTV scoreboard: luchov 38-20, +6.61%, 97.4 ADR, 86.8% KAST, 1.61 rating; HUASOPEEK 1.45; Aurora: Jimpphat 1.19, woxic 0.84, XANTARES 0.81, Wicadia 0.76, kyxsan 0.53 (9-29).

facts.claim: VRS effect: 9z earned 62 points and reached 1571 (third in the Americas).
facts.source_name: HLTV news 45718
facts.detail: Quoted directly: victory 'earned a valuable 62 points in the VRS ranking ... currently third in the Americas with 1571 points'.

facts.claim: Aurora lost 21 VRS points (1817) and moved from 4th to 5th.
facts.source_name: skin.club community news - 9z defeated Aurora at the start of Thunderpick WC 2026
facts.detail: Secondary report; the 9z +62 figure independently matches HLTV. The Aurora -21/1817 figure is not confirmed by HLTV in the same article and is published as secondary.

facts.claim: Rest of day 1 was all 2-0 sweeps: Falcons 2-0 NiP, Legacy 2-0 PARIVISION, FURIA 2-0 BetBoom.
facts.source_name: Hotspawn - FURIA Title Defense Begins After Day 1 of TWC 2026
facts.detail: Legacy 2-0 PARIVISION (Dust2 13-11, Mirage 16-14); FURIA 2-0 BetBoom (Ancient 13-10, Mirage 13-9).

facts.claim: Falcons 2-0 NiP (Ancient 16-13, Dust2 13-6), m0NESY MVP 1.62 rating.
facts.source_name: EGamersWorld news 37819 - Falcons defeat NiP 2-0
facts.detail: Matches the scoreline in the HLTV day-1 news index; used only for the map scores and MVP detail.

facts.claim: Day 2 (15 Oct) order: Aurora vs NiP (A elimination), 9z vs Falcons (A winners), PARIVISION vs BetBoom (B elimination), Legacy vs FURIA (B winners).
facts.source_name: Field Level Media - Thunderpick World Championship opens with 4 group-stage sweeps
facts.detail: Same order as the HLTV event page and the Hotspawn day-2 preview.

facts.claim: Aurora vs NiP was live at read time; map 1 Cache finished 13-9 to Aurora, map 2 Dust2 in progress.

facts.detail: Page state 'LIVE'; veto: NiP removed Anubis, Aurora removed Ancient, NiP picked Cache, Aurora picked Dust2, NiP removed Mirage, Aurora removed Inferno, Nuke left over. Cache 13-9 Aurora (7:5; 6:4). No final series result is published here.

facts.claim: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 facts: 14-18 Oct, Attard/Malta, $1,000,000, 8 teams, GSL Bo3 groups, single-elimination Bo3 playoffs, Bo5 grand final plus a third-place decider.

facts.claim: Identity evidence: Hotspawn 'WROTBERRY' is HLTV/Valve 'WBT' - identical five-player roster.

Four identical player names plus fixture correspondence; the fifth (Tumppis) is not shown as a starter on HLTV at read time, so this row is published with an explicit identity flag.

facts.claim: The project model uses p_map = 1/(1+10^((points_b - points_a)/400)) on official VRS points and exact best-of series maths; the extrapolated rank scale for the ranking fallback is 262 places per 90% favourite.
facts.source_name: Project model - executive/ownlines.py and executive/data/summary.json
facts.detail: Own lines published by this board are labelled project estimates. They are uncalibrated for series-level outcomes and are never described as book prices.
